DIRECTION.note: The primary sensor and every warning sensor, in full (ADR-041). No extra sensor.

ENTRY_TIMING.note: Plus the sensors that supplied the entry zones of the trader's reading (D2 d).

EXIT_TARGETS.note: Plus the sensors with a level beyond the entry on the target side of the synthesis bias (D2 e).

RISK_SIZING.note: Board only: the always set and no extra sensor (4.5).

EXPLAIN.note: Plus the sensor that owns the term in the question; when several own it, the primary sensor and the sensor of the timeframe the question names (D2 c).

NEWS.note: The always set only; the upcoming events travel with the packet (D9 b).

REPORT_2.note: No readings: Section 6 reads the pinned cycle by id (D2 g, D9 a).

OUT_OF_SCOPE.note: Nothing runs: a fixed reply (D2 g).

INSTANT_M5_INSPECT.note: Plus the sensors that read the M5 channel (D10 b).

INSTANT_M15_INSPECT.note: Plus the sensors that read the M15 channel (D10 b).
